test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and Il. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

Some beds are tables.

All beds are chairs.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some chairs are tables.

Il. No chair is a table.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follow:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33d0fd420812376c192f77bdfd5b53cb3824d358120b4688b2dc58cbcb20bfae.png] 

**Conclusions: **

I. Some chairs are tables → **True** (All beds are chairs and some beds are tables, so some chairs are also tables, hence, true)

II. No Chair is Table → **False** (All beds are chairs given so some part of beds is also table. So, it is definitely false) 

Hence, only conclusion I follows.
